description:
Full planning application for development of residential
homes (Use Class C3), commercial uses (Use Class E), and health centre (Use
Class E(e)) with associated landscaping, car parking, and cycle parking.

(This is an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
application and is accompanied by an EIA Conformity Statement).   

Further explanation (not forming part of the formal
description of development):

A residential‑led mixed‑use development on land at Kodak
Masterplan site, Plots A2–A5, comprising 772x residential dwellings (Use Class
C3), 845 sqm of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E), and a 1,349 sqm
healthcare facility (Use Class E(e)), within buildings ranging from
approximately 6 to 16 storeys, together with associated landscaping, car parking
(62 spaces), and cycle parking (710 spaces provided with a further 95 spaces
safeguarded depending on demand).
